text:
Predicates:
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in city y.
American(x) ::: x is American.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
WroteBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is an author of y.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
City(y) ::: y is a city.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
InYear(x, y) ::: x was created in year y.
Uncertain(x) ::: x is uncertain.
------------------------------
Premises:
∀x (BornIn(x, Boston) → American(x)) ::: If a person was born in Boston, then they are American.
∀x (Novel(x) ∧ WroteBy(x, y) → ∃z (Author(z, y) ∧ Novel(z))) ::: If a book is a novel and written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
Book(familyHistory) ∧ Author(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ∧ InYear(familyHistory, 2003) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro, in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created Family Secrets.
City(boston) ::: Boston is a city.
DaniShapiro is an American writer. ::: (This is an explicit statement, but for logic, it can be represented as American(daniShapiro).)
------------------------------
Conclusion:
BornIn(daniShapiro, boston) ::: Dani Shapiro was born in Boston.
